name: Kontaktformular
description: Puts a form into the page where [[formular]] stands, takes the messages and collects them in the administration. Forms of your own with your own fields can be assembled and placed with [[formular:key]]. With a notification address stored, an e-mail goes out for every enquiry; with receipts switched on for the website, the sender is told it arrived. Against spam: a honeypot, a signed timestamp and an hourly limit. The messages that came in can be downloaded as a table.
author: Holzcloud
